atoms.text: The Great Heathen Army was very big and well-organised. In contrast, Anglo-Saxon armies, called fyrds, were smaller and only came together for short periods of time when they were needed. People in fyrds also had to provide their own food and weapons.

atoms.b: Jorvik was a very ((++important useless)) town, and we can learn a lot about Viking life from things that have been dug up there.
atoms.sound: Yorvik was a very important town, and we can learn a lot about Viking life from things that have been dug up there.

instruction.text: Select the soil to uncover objects from Jorvik.

end.text: At a dig in York, archaeologists discovered wooden bowls, leather shoes and coins that the Vikings in Jorvik used.
end.sound: At a dig in York, archaeologists discovered wooden bowls, leather shoes and coins that the Vikings in Yorvik used.

feedback.end: Archaeologists also found amber beads, which provide evidence of skilled craft and industry. Amber jewellery was highly prized and very useful for when the Vikings traded with other peoples around the world.
